description: Read the pinned registry’s objects. action list returns the objects in use, business objects first, each with its source, traits and field count; domain, trait and maturity filter it, and includeInternal adds OODS Foundry’s internal objects, which hiddenInternal counts otherwise. action show, with name, returns one object’s composed definition: traits, fields and their semantics, view extensions by context, tokens and relationships; context narrows the view extensions to one context. Use registry_snapshot instead for an overview of every object and trait, and design_preview to see a generated screen of an object. Only list and show answer here; validate, register and reload belong to the local package.

inputSchema.description: Read object definitions from the pinned registry.

action.description: List objects or show one composed definition.

context.description: Optional: filter view_extensions to a single context (e.g. 'detail', 'list', 'form', 'timeline', 'card', 'inline')

domain.description: Filter to objects in a specific domain (e.g. 'core.identity', 'saas.billing')

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and hiddenInternal counts them.

trait.description: Filter to objects composing a given trait (e.g. 'Priceable', 'lifecycle/Stateful')

inputSchema.title: object input

name: object_registry
title: Read Object Registry
